heading: Tell the tale of our humble beginnings and how we’ve grown along the way.
paragraph: Since its inception, KeyDevs Technologies has come a long way as a web and mobile app development company. Our journey has been incredible, and we continue to thrive in delivering seamless digital transformation solutions for startups and enterprises alike

items.title: The Beginning
items.text: KeyDevs Technologies was born as a small group of passionate freelancers, setting the foundation for a tech-driven future.

items.title: Early Growth
items.text: The team expanded, taking on its first significant web and mobile app development projects for local clients.

items.title: First Milestone
items.text: Officially incorporated, KeyDevs started gaining attention from larger clients, marking its entry into the global tech scene.

items.title: Stepping into the Global Market
items.text: Successfully delivered projects for international clients, making waves in the web and mobile app development space.

items.title: Innovative Leap
items.text: Introduced innovative AR and VR solutions, tapping into new sectors like gaming, education, and healthcare.

items.title: New Horizons
items.text: Opened its first international office in the USA, expanding its global reach and setting a solid foothold.

items.title: Diversification
items.text: Broadened service offerings, including e-commerce and enterprise-grade solutions, attracting diverse industries.

items.title: Navigating the Pandemic
items.text: Despite the global challenges, KeyDevs thrived by helping businesses adapt to digital transformation rapidly.

items.title: Scaling New Heights
items.text: Established itself as a market leader in custom mobile app and game development, catering to both startups and enterprises.

items.title: Tech Innovation
items.text: Launched groundbreaking solutions in AI, blockchain, and IoT, cementing its place as a forward-thinking tech company.

items.title: Global Recognition
items.text: KeyDevs was recognized among the top digital agencies globally, working with high-profile clients from around the world.

items.title: Future-Ready
items.text: Continued growth with a clear focus on delivering cutting-edge digital transformation solutions and expanding its global presence.
